infrastructure.reporting_integrity: DEC-255 / DAL-261 (2026-07-30): audited every external API reader. Fixed 5 defects. traffic_report.py read 200 of 1,703 GSC query rows and computed a SET DIFFERENCE from the slice, so 9 of the 10 'new queries' in Benedict's daily email were queries we already ranked for and position movers showed 11 of a true 392. resend_report.py kept an unpaginated copy of fetch_emails (the DEC-250 bug in the sibling file): 100 emails became 1,838. resend_report.py also counted delivery as last_event=='delivered', but last_event is the FURTHEST state reached, so every opened/clicked email counted as undelivered and the delivery rate FELL as engagement ROSE (52.5% reported against a true 100% delivered, 0 bounced). daily-digest.py's engagement stamp took one page of 50 issues, and that gates whether Dale strikes (DEC-226), so an unseen signal read as absence. nursery_crm.outbound_clicks ran off a 40-page cap silently and now warns PARTIAL. Audited clean: plausible_stats.py (honest top-N), linear_poller.py, linear_update.py archive-stale, gsc_analysis.py, resend_engagement.py, treesmith_analytics.py, uptime_monitor.py. Guard is tests/test_api_pagination.py, which drives each real fetcher against a saturated first page.
infrastructure.email_reply_path: DEC-257 CORRECTION to Q46. treestock.com.au's APEX already has Fastmail MX (in1/in2-smtp.messagingengine.com) and has received email the whole time. The defect is narrower and entirely ours: we send From alerts@mail.treestock.com.au, a SUBDOMAIN with no MX, and stocklib/mailer.py:112 sets no Reply-To at all, so replies are addressed somewhere that cannot receive them. Fix is ONE LINE pointing Reply-To at an apex address (DAL-243), not a new service and not a DNS change. Do NOT add MX to the sending subdomain. The same mailbox answers DAL-80's BCC ask via a Fastmail alias + an IMAP-scoped app password (revocable, cannot send); imap.fastmail.com:993 is reachable from this server, verified. Cloudflare Email Routing considered and rejected: MX change on a live domain, a Worker, and a token scope we do not hold, to duplicate a mailbox we already own.
